A '''Mandalorian Militiaman''' was a type of soldier native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Mandalorian Militiamen fought against invading forces on Mandalore during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were stationed in various [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] around the planet. They wore modified sets of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] and often wielded [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifles]] similar in design to the [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3 carbine rifle]].<ref name="EOW" />
